issues: Light grey background with dark grey text, and the flash only swapped between two greys (#ececea / #cfcfca), so it barely registered and had none of an anime finisher card's punch
The words were a plain bold sans at about half the frame width, all the same size, with no poster quality
A debug title 'CEL FLASH STOMP' sat in the top-left and the bottom label bar was an empty placeholder block
Three evenly spaced 30f beats made the rhythm flat, and the closing hold had nothing on screen but the word
changes: Ember look: the resting background is a warm-black lit stage, and from each landing frame the whole background hard-cuts between ember orange and warm black every 2f; the last word gets 8f with a brighter orange and deeper black

Type is now Avenir Next Condensed Heavy Italic caps, sized per word (560 / 470 / 520px) to fill 62-72% of the width, with a cream face and an 18-layer rust extrusion that reads on both dark and orange, so the text never changes during the flash

A heavier slam: each word starts at 1.32x with two scaled ghost trails and a lift shadow that tightens from wide and soft to tight, drops to 0.97 in 4f, settles in 2f, alternating +/-3 degrees and squaring up on the last word
The beats tighten, SHIP 30f, FASTER 26f, then TODAY, like drums accelerating into the final hit

The debug title is replaced by a 01/03 beat counter and version tag; when the last flash ends, a release line (orange version pill, 40px copy, domain) rises in pieces, followed by a 50f hold with a 1.5% slow push
